<function name="GravGunPunt" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<description>
Called when this entity is about to be punted with the gravity gun (primary fire).

Only works in Sandbox derived gamemodes and only if <page>GM:GravGunPunt</page> is not overridden.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player pressing left-click with the gravity gun at an entity</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Return true or false to enable or disable punting respectively.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Enables a scripted entity to be punted even when frozen.</description>
	<code>
function ENT:GravGunPunt( ply )
	self:PhysWake()
	return true
end
	</code>

</example>
